textos: Will the government force you to stay in your neighbourhood?
This is the 15-minute city: your everyday needs a short walk from home.
Living, working, shopping, healthcare, learning and leisure, 15 minutes away on foot or by bike.
Urbanist Carlos Moreno proposed it in 2016. Paris made it its flagship in 2020.
In 2023 it went viral in Oxford, mixed up with a plan for traffic filters.
Cameras limit cars on six streets. On foot, by bike or by bus, you can always pass.
No physical barriers: you can still drive anywhere, even if you go the long way.
In 1929, Clarence Perry drew neighbourhoods with the school at the centre and everything within 400 metres.
What's within 15 minutes of your home?
